correctness.rationale: The two-of-three local rule yields a complete disjoint classification: one differing rung forces both layers constant; otherwise equal rungs give cyclic words with no singleton run. Cyclic boundaries are counted by n/r times binomial(n-r-1,r-1); proper run colouring uses the cycle chromatic polynomial, including the r=2 two-boundary case. Formal logarithms produce the Lucas and rational identities. Exhaustive direct checks of 2,065,492 assignments over 14 cases and additional 147 closed-form/series checks passed. The algebraic proof covers all n>=3, k>=1.
